package handlers

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/usecase/diagnosticplan"
	"github.com/go-chi/chi/v5"
)

type placementHandlerRepo struct {
	plan     domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord
	decision domain.DiagnosticPlacementRecord
}

func (r *placementHandlerRepo) GetByStudentKey(context.Context, string, string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord, error) {
	return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord{}, domain.ErrNotFound
}
func (r *placementHandlerRepo) GetDiagnosticByID(_ context.Context, id string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord, error) {
	if r.plan.Plan.ID != id {
		return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return r.plan, nil
}
func (r *placementHandlerRepo) GetLatest(context.Context, string, string, string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord, error) {
	return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord{}, domain.ErrNotFound
}
func (r *placementHandlerRepo) Insert(context.Context, domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord, error) {
	return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord{}, errors.New("unused")
}
func (r *placementHandlerRepo) GetDiagnosticPlacement(_ context.Context, id string) (domain.DiagnosticPlacementRecord, error) {
	if r.decision.Decision.PlanID != id {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacementRecord{}, domain.ErrNotFound
	}
	return r.decision, nil
}
func (r *placementHandlerRepo) InsertDiagnosticPlacement(_ context.Context, d domain.DiagnosticPlacementRecord) (domain.DiagnosticPlacementRecord, error) {
	if r.decision.Decision.PlanID != "" {
		return domain.DiagnosticPlacementRecord{}, domain.ErrConflict
	}
	r.decision = d
	return d, nil
}

type placementHandlerStudent struct {
	result domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResult
	calls  int
}

func (s *placementHandlerStudent) ReserveDiagnosticAssessment(context.Context, string, domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentReservation, error) {
	return domain.DiagnosticAssessmentReservation{}, errors.New("unused")
}
func (s *placementHandlerStudent) GetDiagnosticAssessmentResult(context.Context, string, string) (domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResult, error) {
	s.calls++
	return s.result, nil
}

type placementHandlerClock struct{}

func (placementHandlerClock) Now() time.Time { return time.Date(2026, 1, 3, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC) }

func TestDiagnosticPlacementHandlerStrictPostAndOwnerScopedGet(t *testing.T) {
	plan := placementHandlerPlan(t)
	result := domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResult{Schema: domain.DiagnosticAssessmentResultSchemaV1, StudentID: plan.StudentID, CourseID: plan.CourseID, CourseContentRevision: plan.CourseRevision, PolicyVersion: plan.PolicyVersion, AttemptID: plan.ID, PlanID: plan.ID, PlanRevision: 1, Correct: 0, Total: 3, Percent: 0, Band: "FOUNDATION", BandPolicyVersion: domain.DiagnosticAssessmentBandPolicyV1, PlanDigest: plan.PlanDigest, CompletedAt: time.Date(2026, 1, 2, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)}
	result.ResultDigest, _ = domain.DiagnosticResultDigest(result)
	repo := &placementHandlerRepo{plan: domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanRecord{Plan: plan}}
	student := &placementHandlerStudent{result: result}
	h := DiagnosticPlacementHandler{Placement: diagnosticplan.PlacementConsumer{Plans: repo, Placements: repo, Students: student, Clock: placementHandlerClock{}}}
	path := "/internal/students/" + plan.StudentID + "/diagnostic-assessment-plans/" + plan.ID + "/placement"
	for _, tc := range []struct {
		body, key string
		want      int
	}{{`{"schema":"wrong"}`, plan.ID, http.StatusUnprocessableEntity}, {`{"schema":"diagnostic-placement-consume.v1","x":true}`, plan.ID, http.StatusBadRequest}, {`{"schema":"diagnostic-placement-consume.v1"}`, "other", http.StatusBadRequest}} {
		r := placementHandlerRequest(http.MethodPost, path, strings.NewReader(tc.body), plan.StudentID, plan.ID)
		r.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		r.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", tc.key)
		w := httptest.NewRecorder()
		h.Consume(w, r)
		if w.Code != tc.want || w.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" {
			t.Fatalf("post %s status=%d", tc.body, w.Code)
		}
	}
	r := placementHandlerRequest(http.MethodPost, path, strings.NewReader(`{"schema":"diagnostic-placement-consume.v1"}`), plan.StudentID, plan.ID)
	r.Header.Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	r.Header.Set("Idempotency-Key", plan.ID)
	w := httptest.NewRecorder()
	h.Consume(w, r)
	if w.Code != http.StatusOK || student.calls != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("consume=%d calls=%d %s", w.Code, student.calls, w.Body.String())
	}
	r = placementHandlerRequest(http.MethodGet, path, nil, plan.StudentID, plan.ID)
	w = httptest.NewRecorder()
	h.Get(w, r)
	if w.Code != http.StatusOK || w.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" {
		t.Fatalf("get=%d", w.Code)
	}
	r = placementHandlerRequest(http.MethodGet, "/internal/students/99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999/diagnostic-assessment-plans/"+plan.ID+"/placement", nil, "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999", plan.ID)
	w = httptest.NewRecorder()
	h.Get(w, r)
	if w.Code != http.StatusNotFound || w.Header().Get("Cache-Control") != "no-store" {
		t.Fatalf("foreign get=%d", w.Code)
	}
}

func placementHandlerRequest(method, path string, body io.Reader, studentID, planID string) *http.Request {
	r := httptest.NewRequest(method, path, body)
	ctx := chi.NewRouteContext()
	ctx.URLParams.Add("studentID", studentID)
	ctx.URLParams.Add("planID", planID)
	return r.WithContext(context.WithValue(r.Context(), chi.RouteCtxKey, ctx))
}

func placementHandlerPlan(t *testing.T) domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan {
	t.Helper()
	p := domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{Schema: domain.DiagnosticAssessmentPlanSchemaV1, ID: "11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", StudentID: "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222", CourseID: "33333333-3333-4333-8333-333333333333", PlanRevision: 1, PolicyVersion: domain.DiagnosticFixedPolicyV1, OnboardingVersion: 1, BootstrapPolicyVersion: domain.DiagnosticBootstrapPolicyV1, BootstrapContextDigest: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("b", 64), CourseRevision: "sha256:" + strings.Repeat("a", 64), CreatedAt: time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)}
	for i := 0; i < 3; i++ {
		p.Assessments = append(p.Assessments, domain.DiagnosticAssessment{LessonID: fmt.Sprintf("44444444-4444-4444-8444-%012d", i), TaskID: fmt.Sprintf("55555555-5555-4555-8555-%012d", i), TaskVersion: 1, UpdatedAt: time.Date(2026, 1, 1, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC), LessonOrder: i})
	}
	p.PlanDigest, _ = domain.DiagnosticPlanDigest(p)
	return p
}

var _ = json.Valid
